mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < -1% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and CPIAUCSL is below 2% YoY, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 300,000 MoM and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% MoM, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY < -10% and UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY < -10% and UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
